name: s3-sustained-intent-live-sonnet
brief: Two neighbours run their owners' errands around the hamlet, then meet in the pond hall and each gives one short talk about their morning.

seats.character: Ada is cheerful and keeps bees.
Bo is shy and plays music.

script.line: ada: please walk over to the orchard, and after that go and sit on the bench outside the cottage
bo: walk over to the orchard, please
ada: do you remember where you are going?
ada: tell me when you're there
bo: actually stop, don't go to the orchard after all
bo: say hello to everyone around you
ada: that's all, now walk to the pond hall and wait for the others
bo: that's all, now walk to the pond hall and wait for the others

lean.guidance: Keep it cheap: do just this with one or two commands, no exploring, then wait for my next message.

normal.guidance: Do just this, then wait for my next message.

rich.guidance: Take the time you need to do this well, then wait for my next message.
